userStories.notes: Done. Ran the full verification gauntlet against the in-flight US-001..US-009 work, fixed three issues that only surfaced once the production-built SPA met the Docker-pinned chromium-linux baselines, and landed the refactor as one commit. Issues found + fixed (none caught by typecheck/lint/unit tests): (1) `packages/canvas/src/lib/node-defaults.ts` — `buildNewShapeData` still returned `data: { shape: GeometricNodeType, ... }`, which the strict on-disk FlowGeometricNodeData schema rejected (shape is neither in NODE_DATA_FLOW_KEYS nor NODE_STYLE_KEYS, so merge.ts routes it to flow.json where .strict() catches it). Caught by the US-009 e2e draw-mode test ('Couldn't save change: Flow failed schema validation'). Removed the field from both the return value and the ShapeDataDefaults interface; updated the 2 test assertions in node-defaults.test.ts to assert `'shape' in data === false`. Per the design doc's flat-schema contract, `type` IS the shape — there's no shape field anywhere on data anymore. (2) `apps/studio/integration/fixtures/kitchen-sink.flow.json` — n3 (ellipse) had `name: 'Shape'` but no description. Under the flat-schema GeometricNode renderer, ellipse renders as a description-only label (renderSingleLabelAsDescription=true since it's in {ellipse, sticky}); with no description, the rendered text was empty and broke the e2e suite's `not.toHaveText('')` smoke check. Added a description field. (3) `apps/studio/e2e/canvas.e2e.ts` — the draw-mode US-009 test referenced `toolbar-shape-database` (testid for top-level toolbar buttons), but database lives behind the shape-picker popover under testid `shape-picker-database` (only rectangle + ellipse sit at the top level). Rewrote the test to (a) click toolbar-shape-picker, (b) click shape-picker-database, (c) assert draw mode is armed via `data-canvas-mode='draw'` on the canvas root, (d) dispatch pointer events directly on `.react-flow__pane` via `pane.dispatchEvent()` so the canvas's `target.classList.contains('react-flow__pane')` gate accepts them regardless of DOM overlays. (4) `apps/studio/integration/rest.it.ts` — the 'external flow.json edit triggers a flow:reload SSE event' test had a 3s timeout for the fs.watch debounce + reparse + SSE broadcast pipeline; that's too tight on macOS under orchestrator load (the test would consistently fail in `bun run test:it` then pass when re-run in isolation). Bumped to 8s. The edges.it.ts version of the same test stays at 1s — that one's PRD-contract-bound and was already reliable. Production rebuild note: vite.config.ts aliases `@seeflow/canvas` → `packages/canvas/src/index.ts` in both dev and build modes, so a fresh `apps/web` build picks up canvas source changes without needing to re-publish dist/. But the studio's prod-mode SPA is `apps/studio/dist/web/`, which is a static bundle from the apps/web build. Anytime canvas source changes during refactor work, run `bun run --filter @seeflow/web build` to refresh the studio's prod SPA — the test-integration.ts orchestrator's freshness check (mtime comparison) catches missed rebuilds automatically, but the run-e2e.ts dispatcher does NOT, so e2e through Docker would otherwise use a stale SPA. Verification gates (all passing on the final committed HEAD): bun run typecheck (0 errors), bun run format (0 changes), bun run lint (0 errors), bun test (1694 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail / 84 files), bun run test:it (integration: 121 pass / 0 fail / 10 files / 12s; e2e: 6 pass / 0 fail / 80s through Playwright Docker on Darwin). Snapshots generated: 7 chromium-linux PNGs under apps/studio/e2e/canvas.e2e.ts-snapshots/ — rectangle/database/ellipse/image/html/icon (per-node baselines) + render-matrix (12-tag visual regression spine). 6 legacy *Node-chromium-linux.png files deleted (playNode/stateNode/shapeNode/imageNode/iconNode/htmlNode). No *-darwin.png or other host-specific snapshots created. Final commit lands US-001..US-010 as one atomic refactor: 'refactor(schema)!: flatten node types — flat type tags, capabilities are fields' citing docs/plans/2026-05-23-flat-node-types-design.md and the c48899e WIP checkpoint. git status post-commit is clean.
